title: RISE Live: who makes the pictures (RISE's own visuals, the model that answers, or another model), and native scenes read as a model means them
acceptance: The venue's quiet line reads 'Answered by … · pictures by … · spoken by …' for a model; the Demo names no pictures choice. The pictures name opens 'Who makes the pictures': RISE's own visuals, the model that answers, another OpenRouter model (with a Model field; not offered with a keyed provider). The choice is kept as a setting.
Unchosen, a free OpenRouter model (':free') shows RISE's own visuals; any other draws its own.

RISE's own visuals: the composer is taught only the native engines (no figure, code scene, illustrator or listening scene), its prompt about a third smaller; a figure or code scene written all the same is refused by name; a picture asked for that no engine answers is let go without a failure shown, and no illustrator request is made; an engine's cue or an engine still answers.
Another model: the illustrator's requests go to that model's adapter on the same OpenRouter connection, never the room's, and are counted with the reading.
The default instructions are unchanged, byte for byte.

A native scene line in a shape that means one thing is read so: an engine fused with one of its values, an engine with no id (bare values to the one parameter holding each), and a declared scene started by the next beat when that beat names none. A free model in a room of RISE's own visuals shows a visual in most readings.

evidence.note: Branch live-pictures (on live-openrouter-models). npx vitest run src/live/adapter.test.js src/live/host src/live/adapters src/live/runtime.illustrator.test.js src/live/runtime.test.js src/app.safety.test.js: 47 files, 1280 passed, 4 skipped; after the parser change, src/live/adapters with the runtime v2, illustrator, room, catalog and interjection suites and illustrator.test.js: 35 files, 668 passed. REALTIME_INSTRUCTIONS compared with main's: identical.

Agent observation, not a human's: five real questions to nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free through RISE's own adapter and parser, on the owner's key, $0. A room of RISE's own visuals: prompt 3,555 to 2,290 tokens; every reading complete, none refused. Before the parser change the model wrote four @scene lines and none was kept; after it, five of five kept (attractor, genesis, genesis, fractal, neural), every reading with a visual. With drawing allowed: three readings of five had a visual (the model wrote no scene in two).

activity.summary: Created on the owner's go for the pictures plan (RISE only, then another model; the default RISE only for free models; the choice in the quiet line). Built on branch live-pictures. Not merged, not deployed, not accepted by a human.

summary: Who makes a Live reading's pictures (RISE's own visuals, the model that answers, or another OpenRouter model), chosen in the venue's quiet line; and native scene lines read as a model means them, so a free model's readings have visuals.
